themes.title: Anthropic's $1T IPO reprices the AI trade
themes.summary: Anthropic priced its IPO at $83 per share, far above the planned range, raising about $81 billion and valuing the company at over $1 trillion. Shares jumped 17% on debut, but the broader market sold off more than 2% and after-hours trading turned negative on Apple's AI agent plans. Gulf investors are sitting on major paper gains from the listing.
themes.angle: The largest tech IPO in history is now the reference price for every AI valuation conversation.

themes.title: Chip export whiplash hits Nvidia, AMD, China
themes.summary: Washington approved sales of Nvidia and AMD chips to Chinese companies, even as the Pentagon flagged PLA-linked buyers, while California probes whether Nvidia misled investors about China risk. AMD shares slid up to 11% after a short-seller report, and Nvidia-backed Nscale's $35bn IPO is threatened by entity-list exposure. China's Moonshot AI scrapped a $150m Indonesia chip deal.
themes.angle: Export policy is oscillating faster than any board can model.

themes.title: Apple, ServiceNow escalate agentic race
themes.summary: Apple is developing an autonomous AI agent to rival Meta and OpenAI, per The Information, and Anthropic shares fell more than 3% after hours on the news. ServiceNow is separately building an AI weapon aimed at Salesforce customers. Agentic AI is now a platform war with distribution at stake.
themes.angle: Agents, not assistants, are the new battleground.

themes.title: Gemini 4 Neon: cheaper agentic coding
themes.summary: Google DeepMind keeps shipping: Gemini 4 Neon is positioned as a cheaper coding-agent alternative to the heavier Carbon, continuing a rapid release run. DeepMind's Melvin Johnson says the Gemini 4 teams roughly halved agent fabrication to about 1.5% and are pushing toward zero. The pattern is price deflation at the frontier while agents get more reliable.
themes.angle: Watch inference economics, not just benchmark scores.

themes.title: AI's externalities: emissions, cyber, labor
themes.summary: Meta's greenhouse gas emissions rose 45% last year on its AI buildout and it is reconsidering its 2030 net-zero goal. Germany's BSI calls the threat level critical amid an AI-driven surge in cyber attacks, and an Anthropic researcher warns superhuman AI could leave many workers permanently unemployable. Boards face a widening risk register tied directly to AI scaling.
themes.angle: AI's cost curve now includes climate, security, and workforce risk.

themes.title: GCC AI momentum: Aramco, SWFs, talent
themes.summary: Saudi Aramco says AI generates $2.6 billion of annual value and is expanding its data center business, while Gulf sovereign funds poured $29.3 billion into global tech investments. The UAE AI Office joined UNDP and Women in AI to launch an initiative to empower 100,000 Arab women in AI, SDAIA began a Year of Artificial Intelligence across Saudi universities, and Arabic-first speech AI is emerging. One contrarian note: analysts argue water, not chips, is the Gulf's real AI constraint.
themes.angle: The Gulf is converting AI ambition into measurable enterprise value.

themes.title: AI dealmaking accelerates
themes.summary: Palo Alto Networks agreed to acquire AI firm Applied Compute for $4.5 billion, and Nvidia is nearing a $500 million-plus acquisition of a diffusion AI developer. themes.angle: M&A and infrastructure bets define the next phase of consolidation.
